name: usage-band
description: Hairline usage band above the prompt in the desktop Code tab: context, 5-hour and weekly limits with reset times underneath, and session cost in euros. Bars turn amber at 80% and red at 95%. Based on desktop-statusline by George Liu (MIT).

eur_rate.title: Dollar to euro rate
eur_rate.description: How many euros one US dollar is worth. Claude reports cost in dollars; the band multiplies by this. Update it now and then.
